about: Ritesh Bhandari is an independent web designer and digital creator. He designs and builds websites and digital experiences for businesses, startups, founders and brands. He has approximately 1 year of hands-on experience and handles projects directly.
experience: Approximately 1 year of hands-on experience working on web projects. He does not claim more than that.
direct_collaboration: Every project is handled directly by Ritesh from the first discussion through delivery. Clients talk to the person doing the work, not an account manager.
focus: Visual quality, clear structure, usability and responsive layouts that work well on phones and desktops.

services.Website Design: Visual direction and layouts that make a brand feel distinct.
services.Website Development: Building the designed site so it is fast, responsive and accessible.
services.Landing Pages: Focused single pages built around one clear action.
services.E-commerce Websites: Online stores designed for browsing and buying.
services.Creative Web Experiences: Motion, interaction and storytelling beyond standard templates.
services.UI/UX Design: Interfaces shaped around how people actually use them.
services.Website Redesign: Refreshing an existing website's look, structure and usability.
services.Interactive Experiences: Custom interactive web pieces for brands and campaigns.

process: Discover: understanding goals, audience and what makes the business different.
Strategy: agreeing structure, content and priorities before design.
Design: crafting the visual language and key screens.
Build: developing the site with performance and accessibility in mind.
Launch: testing, going live and handing over.

faq.How do I start a project?: Use the Start a Project form on the website, or message Ritesh on WhatsApp or email. Sharing the service you need, budget range, timeline and a short description helps.
faq.What does a project cost?: Pricing is not published. It depends on scope, so please share your requirements and budget range in the enquiry form.
faq.How long does a project take?: Timelines depend on scope and are discussed after the enquiry.
faq.Does Ritesh work with startups and compa: Yes. He works with businesses, startups, founders and brands.
faq.Which technologies does Ritesh use?: Each project page lists the technology used for that project. For anything not listed, please contact Ritesh directly.
faq.Are the projects client work?: Each project is labelled honestly. Most are concept or demo projects for fictional brands, Ricochet Nova is a personal game project, and Jainico is listed as a client project on the Devbit India site. Sample statistics and reviews on concept sites are not Ritesh's achievements.
faq.What is Devbit India?: Devbit India is a separate freelance web development brand. Its website is one of the six portfolio projects.
faq.Which languages can I use with Ritesh AI: You can write or speak in English, Hindi or Hinglish; the assistant replies in the same style.

unknown_policy: If something is not covered here, say the information is not currently available and suggest contacting Ritesh directly.
